segments.normalizedSource: ```swift func absoluteTimeInMicroseconds(timestamp: MTLTimestamp) -> Double { guard ready else { return Double.nan } // Convert the GPU time to a value within the range [0.0, 1.0]. let normalizedGpuTime = (Double(timestamp) - gpuStart) / gpuTimeSpan // Convert GPU time to CPU time. let nanoseconds = (normalizedGpuTime * cpuTimeSpan) + cpuStart let microseconds = nanoseconds / 1e3 return microseconds } ```

segments.normalizedSource: ```objective-c - (double) absoluteTimeInMicroseconds:(MTLTimestamp) timestamp { // Convert the GPU time to a value within the range [0.0, 1.0]. double normalizedGpuTime = ((double)timestamp - self.gpuStart); normalizedGpuTime /= self.gpuTimeSpan; // Convert GPU time to CPU time. double nanoseconds = (normalizedGpuTime * self.cpuTimeSpan); nanoseconds += self.cpuStart; double microseconds = nanoseconds / 1000.0; return microseconds; } ```

segments.normalizedSource: ```swift func printVertexAndFragmentDurations(_ frame: Int) { guard let timestamps = resolvedTimestampSamples else { return } print("\n--- Frame \(frame) ---") if timestamps.count >= 2 { let vertexStart = timestamps[0].timestamp let vertexFinish = timestamps[1].timestamp let vertexTime = timeConverter.microsecondsBetween(begin: vertexStart, end: vertexFinish) let roundedTime = String(format: "%.2f", vertexTime) print(" Vertex duration: \(roundedTime) µS") } if timestamps.count >= 4 { let fragmentStart = timestamps[2].timestamp let fragmentFinish = timestamps[3].timestamp let fragmentTime = timeConverter.microsecondsBetween(begin: fragmentStart, end: fragmentFinish) let roundedTime = String(format: "%.2f", fragmentTime) print(" Fragment duration: \(roundedTime) µS") } } ```

", vertexStart); printf("VF %.2llu
", vertexFinish); double vertexTime; vertexTime = [self.timeConverter microsecondsBetweenBegin:vertexStart end:vertexFinish]; printf(" Vertex duration: %.2f µS
", vertexTime); } if (self.resolvedTimestampSampleCount >= 4) { MTLTimestamp fragmentStart = self.resolvedTimestampSamples[2].timestamp; MTLTimestamp fragmentFinish = self.resolvedTimestampSamples[3].timestamp; double fragmentTime; fragmentTime = [self.timeConverter microsecondsBetweenBegin:fragmentStart end:fragmentFinish]; printf(" Fragment duration: %.2f µS
